summary: Bocconi University in Milan offers international first-year students on its Bachelor's and Law programmes waivers of 100%, 80% or 60% of tuition and fees for 2027-28. The waivers come through one application, Bocconi4Access to Education, and depend on your family's finances.
meta_description: Bocconi4Access gives international first-years 100%, 80% or 60% off tuition and fees in 2027-28. Windows: 12 to 30 November 2026 and 15 March to 5 April 2027.
covers: A waiver of 100%, 80% or 60% of Bocconi's ordinary academic tuition and fees.
Renewal each year for the regular length of the course, if you meet the merit requirements.
There is no cash payment or living allowance in these waivers.
eligibility: International candidates entering the first year of a Bachelor's or Law programme in 2027-28.
Bocconi's Fees, Funding and Housing Office assesses your family's income and assets, and no single factor decides the result.
Applications are considered from the largest benefit down until the money runs out. Students who miss out may be considered for other benefits.
how_to_apply: Apply to Bocconi and complete your enrolment. You can only submit the funding application afterwards, and the portal opens about two hours after enrolment.
Submit the single Bocconi4Access to Education 2027-28 application in your session: Early Session, 12 to 30 November 2026, or Winter Session, 15 March to 5 April 2027.
Results come by 25 February 2027 for the Early Session and by 27 May 2027 for the Winter Session.
watch_out: You must enrol first, and each year you pay a first-instalment advance, which Bocconi reimburses if you qualify.
Bocconi marks these 2027-28 pages as being updated, so check them again before you apply.
Waivers can be lost or revoked under conditions Bocconi lists, and renewal depends on merit.
costs: The waiver covers 100%, 80% or 60%; you pay any remainder

documents: Your Bocconi application and completed enrolment.
The Bocconi4Access to Education 2027-28 application, with the documents on Bocconi's funding documentation list for your family's finances.

faq.q: Does Bocconi offer a full tuition waiver to international students?
faq.a: Yes. Through Bocconi4Access to Education, international first-year students on Bachelor's and Law programmes can get a 100% waiver of tuition and fees, or a partial waiver of 80% or 60%, depending on their family's finances.

faq.q: When do I apply for Bocconi4Access?
faq.a: After you enrol: 12 to 30 November 2026 in the Early Session, or 15 March to 5 April 2027 in the Winter Session.
